profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, traded on public markets under the ticker GOOGL. Its own website, centered on the Gemini product, describes Gemini as Google's AI assistant, offering help with writing, planning, and brainstorming, and positions it as an experience in generative AI. The company reported revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, as filed in a 10-K with the SEC under CIK 0001652044.

Google's tracked AI products span several categories. Gemini serves as its general large language model assistant, while Google AI Studio provides a model prototyping environment for developers. In healthcare, Google offers Med-PaLM and MedLM, described as medical LLMs covering clinical reasoning and healthcare data, with a HIPAA BAA required. Workspace-integrated products include Google Drive AI, Google Meet AI for meeting summaries and live captions, and NotebookLM, which grounds responses in user-uploaded document corpora. TensorFlow and Keras represent Google's open-source machine learning framework contributions, with TensorFlow Extended available for MLOps workflows.

The site's held facts show 187 legal matters associated with California, indicating a substantial litigation footprint in that jurisdiction, though no individual cases are detailed in the available data. Google's services also appear as integration targets across a range of third-party MCP servers, covering Google Ads campaign management, Google Search Console, Google News, Google Calendar, Google Forms, Google OAuth authentication flows, and Google Trends data, reflecting broad adoption of Google APIs within the AI tooling ecosystem.
